Needs a decisionB1ACME-TSR-01 — no cost basis anywhere
What the source said
ACME-TSR-01 | 0000000000000 | Count 12 | (cost column blank)
What the count did

Included the 12 units. The sheet carries no cost and the product has no best_available_cogs, so the line opens a zero-value FIFO layer.

Impact if left as-is

Everything sold from those 12 units books 100% margin until the layer is exhausted, and the opening valuation is understated by whatever they actually cost.

The question
What did ACME-TSR-01 cost? A single landed unit cost is enough — or confirm $0.00 is intended (free samples, consignment).

For the record — no answer needed
